request: What are the estimated budget costs of clean energy tax credits?

reply.reply: The clearest estimate located is a combined one: at enactment, JCT estimated IRA energy tax credits and deductions together would increase deficits by $271 billion over FY2022–FY2031 (CRS R46865, PDF p. 3). CRS gives no separate aggregate for credits alone; its provision-level cost figures are generally JCT tax-expenditure estimates for FY2023–FY2027 (CRS R46865, PDF p. 3). See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-164631-8b64.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: The verified evidence supplies an enactment-era combined estimate, not a clean-energy-credit-only aggregate. I therefore distinguish the scope of the figure and qualify the answer as partial.
